description: Implementation of QuicSpdyStreamBodyManager class managing HTTP/3 stream body data in QUIC protocol.

classes.name: QuicSpdyStreamBodyManager
classes.description: Manages HTTP/3 stream body data for QUIC protocol, handling fragments, consumption, and peeking.

methods.name: OnNonBody
methods.description: Handles non-body bytes, updating trailing count or returning length if fragments are empty.

methods.name: OnBody
methods.description: Adds a body fragment and updates total bytes received.

methods.name: OnBodyConsumed
methods.description: Consumes specified number of bytes from body fragments, updating internal state.

methods.name: PeekBody
methods.description: Provides a view of current body fragments without consuming them.

methods.name: ReadBody
methods.description: Reads body data into provided iovec buffers, updating total bytes read.
